subject: Next: Eval workshop & prompt playbook — calendar options

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + booking: 60m Eval workshop (success criteria & prompt playbook)

Hi Anika — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the eval workshop: 

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary goal: Reduce triage time for CareMetrics support agents by surfacing prioritized case summaries and recommended actions.
- Success criteria (what we'll validate in the eval): 1) 75% of cases where Redwood suggestions save >30s of agent time; 2) precision >= 85% on suggested action labels; 3) no PII leakage on test prompts.
- Technical constraints: prefer VPC-private trial, ~50K messages/day test volume, latency target 250ms p50.

What I propose for the next call (60 minutes):
1) Technical deep dive & environment checklist (Karthik) — network/KMS, endpoint pinning, data ingest format.
2) Prompt playbook review (Ben) — initial prompt set we’ll run in the first sprint and evaluation criteria.
3) Trial plan + success metrics alignment — agree on pass/fail thresholds and data samples.

Calendar options (all PST):
- Tue Nov 24, 09:00–10:00
- Wed Nov 25, 11:00–12:00
- Thu Nov 26, 14:00–15:00

Attachments: I’ve attached the initial prompt CSV and a brief SLA summary. Please ping with your preferred slot or send a calendar invite for whichever works. If these times don’t fit, share 2 alternative windows next week and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks all — confirmed: Wed Nov 25, 11:00–12:00 PST (I’ve built the event and Marissa will send the invite formally).

Quick note on ingest format for the sanitized sample: please provide a CSV with the following headers exactly: sample_id, timestamp_utc, source_channel, anonymized_text, expected_label, confidence_hint. Max 2,000 rows for sprint0. Don’t include any raw PII fields — if you have complex nested payloads, flatten them to anonymized_text.

I’ll also post a short checklist in the calendar invite: VPC peering info, KMS key alias, and S3 pre-signed upload path. Ben — if you can attach the prompt_playbook_template.csv to the invite, that will make it easy for CareMetrics to drop the sample.

See you on Wednesday,
